user.title: Login Detail
user.description: Login Detail records who tries to log in, when, and from which IP address. There is nothing to configure — confirm to add it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Login Detail is already set up.

init.title: Sign-in log
init.description: The sign-in log holds personal data (username, IP address, user agent). Entries are removed when either limit is reached.

data.show_panel: Show the Sign-in log panel in the sidebar (administrators only)
data.store_unknown_usernames: Also store usernames that do not exist (failed logins)

data_description.store_unknown_usernames: Shows what a brute force attempt tries. WARNING: if someone types their password into the username field, it is stored in plain text in the events, the log, the sign-in log, the sensor history, the recorder database and backups. Off by default. Usernames are cut to 64 characters.
